subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository trust and adopt these 13 new executable GitHub Action revisions in its secret-bearing and release workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but accepting new third-party executable SHAs across security, token, publishing, and Codex jobs is an ownership and supply-chain decision that CI alone cannot make.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Have the secops owner verify the upstream tags and revisions, then merge after affected checks complete successfully on the current head.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and Codex Action pins into smaller PRs when owners want independent trust and rollback decisions.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Close or defer this grouped update if any upstream revision cannot be approved or validated for the repository's security boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Have the secops owner verify the upstream tags and revisions, then merge after affected checks complete successfully on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the most security-sensitive touched workflows to this team.
